cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline maths assistant that generates mathematical explanations and Manim animation code for visual learning on low-cost laptops in connectivity-constrained classrooms.

test_prompts.prompt: Create a complete Manim Community Edition Python scene for Primary 3 pupils explaining 3/4. Show one rectangular fraction bar divided into 4 equal parts, shade exactly 3 parts blue, display the fraction label, and finish with a short recap. Return only executable Manim code.

Create a complete Manim Community Edition Python scene for Primary 4 pupils explaining 6 × 4 using an array with exactly 6 rows and 4 objects in each row. Show repeated addition, display the answer 24, and finish with a recap. Return only executable Manim code.
